open_points.subject: _write_form_path
open_points.text: _write_form_path: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer the text of path's elements in their order with the imported OWNER_FORM_PATH_SEPARATOR constant between each two and nowhere else: an element's name written as it stands and, for an element with no name, its position, a tuple's position counted from zero, written as its decimal digits in ASCII with no sign and no leading zero.
open_points.other_text: PathElement fields (exact, no others exist): name: str | None, position: int | None
open_points.question: Must PathElement be constrained so that a nameless element always has a non-negative position, or must _write_form_path define behavior for a nameless element whose position is None or negative?

open_points.other_text: PathElement fields (exact, no others exist): name: str | None, position: int | None
open_points.question: Must PathElement.name be constrained not to contain the imported OWNER_FORM_PATH_SEPARATOR constant, or must the requirement stop demanding both that every name be written unchanged and that the separator occur nowhere except between elements?

open_points.subject: _read_form_path
open_points.text: _read_form_path: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer the path a form field's name writes, one PathElement for each of its parts in their order, the text between one occurrence of the imported OWNER_FORM_PATH_SEPARATOR constant and the next being one part: a part made of ASCII decimal digits alone, at least one, as a PathElement whose position is the whole number they name in decimal, a tuple's position counted from zero, and whose name is None, and every other part as one whose name is the part's text unchanged and whose position is None; a text holding no separator MUST answer a path of one element, and the reading MUST NOT raise for any text.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the inline field-name grammar with a reference to an imported parser or other placed policy symbol whose contract defines the encoding.

open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the inline serialization grammar with a reference to an imported formatter or other placed policy symbol whose contract defines the encoding.

open_points.subject: _render_owner_page
open_points.text: it MUST give the response a header field the imported OWNER_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY_HEADER constant names that forbids every script
open_points.rule: - **Fail-closed на обеих сторонах.** Неразмещённое значение останавливает сборку. Подстановка значения в контекст модели «на всякий случай» запрещена: она молча восстанавливает старое поведение и обесценивает шов.
open_points.question: Provide the complete Content-Security-Policy header value through an imported provider constant, rather than providing only the header-name constant and requiring the generated module to invent the value.
